title: Evidence Pack manifest.json (EVIDENCE-PACK.md, format v0)
description: DELIBERATELY AN OPEN SCHEMA — the one place in this project where unknown members are allowed, because EVIDENCE-PACK.md says additional keys MUST be ignored by verifiers that do not understand them. That is safe here and nowhere else: the manifest is convenience metadata, the normative core of a pack is the .warrants/ store, and deleting the manifest entirely cannot change what the records say. A manifest is NOT evidence: nothing in it is signed or hashed, and a pack is valid because `warrant verify` returns 0 errors and each ski_check re-executes to its stated expect, not because this file asserts it.

means.description: Plain-language meaning of the pinned predicate value. Prose, and prose is never proof — the re-execution is.
